chunking_compare.title: Chunking: where do the cuts fall?
chunking_compare.real: partial: boundaries, counts (342 / 423) and answer-sentence survival are computed live on the 138 passages; semantic chunking and parent-document retrieval are now REAL (computed over the 15 full articles with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, same protocol as the pack's chunking experiment, which the script reproduces exactly at all 6 sizes). Semantic cut points are computed in-page from stored adjacent-sentence cosines. Remaining gap: no overlap-retrieval or recursive-retrieval run, no proposition / late / structure-aware chunking data (need an LLM or long-context embedder), no downstream answer-quality measure, n=20.

embedding_pipeline.title: Text to vector: tokenise, pool, normalise
embedding_pipeline.real: partial: 6 real 384-d MiniLM vectors, norms, cosine/dot/L2 matrices (all reproduced from raw vectors), 2-d PCA and the q01 MaxSim table are real. Approximate: token split is words+punctuation, not WordPiece (pack stores no token ids for the sentences). Toy: document pooling of 6 unrelated sentences. Pending: word-level vectors, real token vectors, Matryoshka/long-context/sparse models, quality at fewer dimensions.

extraction_ner_re.title: Extraction on a real passage: entities, triples and what went wrong
extraction_ner_re.real: done for the open view at demo scale: real open (no type or relation list) run, qwen3.8-flash, 8 passages (p001, p002, p018, p039 + 4 seeded random), compared by code with the stored schema-guided answer (92 vs 69 entities, 62 shared; 80 vs 67 triples; 57 distinct relation phrases, 1 of them in the list of 13; 47 triples share both endpoints with a schema triple). Remaining gap: no human gold graph, so no precision/recall for either run; open triples carry no right/wrong labels; no canonicalisation step (EDC-style) was run

routing_agentic_hybrid.title: Routing, a replayed correct-and-retry loop, and vector+graph fusion
routing_agentic_hybrid.real: partial: retrieval side is real (24 questions, 4 stored runs, recomputed RRF/concat, stored local-search windows and global answers); no live agent exists in the pack, so the loop is a replay of stored runs with a score or oracle grader; j3-semantic-router-classifier is served only by a regex rule router (no embedding/centroid router computed); j3-self-rag and j3-react are served only as the loop shape (no reflection tokens, no thought text: real example pending: no stored agent or Self-RAG run); local/global shown from stored files, no head-to-head with answers

query_transformation.title: Query transformation on real stored outputs (HyDE, step-back, multi-query, decomposition)
query_transformation.real: partial: HyDE, step-back, multi-query and decomposition are real (20 stored items, real qwen3.7-plus texts, 6 stored retrieval runs, recall recomputed and equal to metrics_by_method); j3-text-to-cypher and j3-text-to-sql are now REAL (done): data/text_to_query.real.json holds 12 questions x SQL and Cypher written by qwen3.7-flash, executed on SQLite and Kuzu 0.11.3 and compared with a gold answer; the remaining gap is j3-query-rewriting, which still uses the multi-query variants as a proxy (no trained rewriter), and text-to-SPARQL (j3-text-to-sparql) has no run (no triple store or RDF data in the pack)

entity_resolution.title: Entity resolution on the real graph: block, match, cluster
entity_resolution.real: partial: blocking counts and clusters real and reproduced from graph.json; P/R/F1 on labelled pairs (37 hand-picked; 163 = 43 merged + 120 random of a 402-pair pool); B-cubed and pairwise P/R/F1 now real on a gold sample of 60 nodes (67 surface forms): pack as built B-cubed P 0.985 R 0.910 F1 0.946, pairwise P 0.857 R 0.429 F1 0.571; Jaccard>=0.5 gives P 0.367 R 1.000. Remaining gap: the gold is one labeller (LLM proposal + our re-read), 60 of 662 nodes, only 5 gold groups join different nodes; no human gold standard, no second labeller, no pair completeness for the whole graph

graph_algorithms_lab.title: Graph algorithms lab on the real graph
graph_algorithms_lab.real: done: real 662-node graph (scores on all nodes, 516-node largest component drawn); scores recomputed in JS and equal networkx (<1e-9), the J4 record numbers (hub graph and full-graph top 5 of PageRank/betweenness/degree), all 23 stored PPR runs in graph/ppr.json (6 digits) and Q = 0.8505 of the stored Leiden partition. Leiden itself is the pack's stored run, not recomputed in the page
